_ConnectionStrings_note: Password is injected at runtime (ConnectionStrings__App via env var / user-secrets); never committed. Single pol_app principal for every runtime cluster (task 8, '1 principal' — RLS teardown retired the separate pol_admin bypass role).
_AdminAuth_note: Confidential OIDC clients for the admin BFF login (REQ-1/2/8), one per provider (google/microsoft in the URL path). Secrets are injected at runtime (AdminAuth__Providers__{Provider}__ClientSecret), never committed. A blank ClientId disables that provider; zero configured providers -> fail-fast at boot outside Development. Microsoft Authority is the single-tenant Entra v2 endpoint (set the real tenant id); AllowedTenants is an optional extra tid gate.
_AdminSession_note: Server-side admin session lifetime + cookie posture (REQ-3/5/7). SameSite=Lax assumes admin SPA + API are same-site; set None for a cross-site deploy. ReturnUrlAllowlist is the open-redirect allowlist for post-login returnTo (same-origin paths only).
_MerchantAuth_note: Merchant-user BFF login (producer-google-sso REQ-8/9/14/17). A SECOND set of confidential OIDC clients, fully isolated from AdminAuth: distinct 'MerchantUser{Provider}' schemes + /api/v1/merchants/auth/{provider}/callback + mch_* cookies. Secrets are injected at runtime (MerchantAuth__Providers__{Provider}__ClientSecret), never committed. A blank ClientId -> that provider's scheme is skipped (login disabled for it) rather than faulting the host. RegisterUrl is the merchant-user SPA register page the callback redirects an applicant to with a signed ticket. Microsoft Authority default 'organizations' = any Entra org tenant; narrow via a tenant-id Authority or AllowedTenants.
_MerchantUserSession_note: Server-side merchant-user session lifetime + cookie posture (SameSite=Lax assumes merchant-user SPA + API same-site).
_AdminAllowlist_note: Bootstrap allowlist for the first Super admin(s): Google subjects allowed to self-provision as Super on first login (admin-actor-rename REQ-5). Empty here; set per env via AdminAllowlist__Subjects__0. Bootstrap-only gate — removing a subject does NOT revoke an existing admin (suspend via POST /api/v1/admins/{id}/suspend). Empty outside Development logs a fail-closed boot warning.
_Cors_note: Browser SPA frontend origins. AllowedOrigins = merchant-user console (cookie XHR, credentialed — the default policy); AdminOrigins = admin console (cookie XHR, credentialed). Empty here (no cross-origin allowed); set per env via Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 / Cors__AdminOrigins__0.
_AuditAnchor_note: Signed audit high-water checkpoints are stored outside SQL. Development/Testing may leave both values blank. Every other environment must mount a persistent append-only path and a separate non-zero 32-byte base64 signing-key file.
_Psp_note: Non-secret PSP endpoint/environment config (Payments.Infrastructure/Psp/PspOptions.cs). PublicBaseUrl is this API's public origin; the per-connection backend-notification URL handed to a PSP is derived from it ({PublicBaseUrl}/api/v1/webhooks/{pspConnectionId}). Blank here so the local host and the test suite boot on the committed defaults; set per env via Psp__PublicBaseUrl. Outside Development a blank or non-absolute value fails fast at boot (captive-payment-alignment REQ-4.3/4.6).
